excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content:
Take this as an early release before the devnet is launched if people want to start experimenting stuff -- mainly since we changed to progressive SSZ and simplified the ChainConfig part.

The R2 bucket and similars will appear eventually when the devnet is live and somewhat stable. In the meantime feel free to provide feedback if you happen to try this out!
